state.description: Construct a 230 kV line with B1272 ACSR from Jasper to Okatie 230/115kV Substation. The line is estimated to be 6.5 miles long. This makes Jasper a Medium Impact substation and will require a new CIP Hut.
state.need: This project is needed to improve system performance and to meet NERC TPL and internal DESC Planning Criteria for reliability.

q.instructions: Does the stated project need contradict the project description?

criteria.true: The need talks about equipment or work that the description and title never mention (likely copied from another project).
criteria.false: The need is generic (load growth, reliability, end of life) or matches the described work.
